propositions: AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE journal marker is emitted by autodeploy.sh but not published as a CloudWatch metric, making pressure-prune activity invisible without host journal access
All sibling autodeploy markers (DEFERRED, REVIEW_INTERRUPT, ERROR) have corresponding metrics, but AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE lacks one, creating inconsistency
Missing metric prevented root-cause diagnosis during disk pressure incidents by making it impossible to distinguish whether reclaim gate executed at all
Metric should be published dimensionlessly via existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with record-anchored ERE and offset-file tracking
Counter must seed to 0 on first run and report deltas thereafter, matching behavior of existing marker counters
Runbook documentation should explain that the counter distinguishes gate-did-not-run from gate-ran-and-reclaimed-nothing scenarios
